d: An England vs Republic of Ireland match at the inaugural FIFA Under-15 World Cup was abandoned after an England player alleged that an Irish opponent had used a racist slur. England were trailing 4-1 in Baku, Azerbaijan, when the incident led to the team leaving the pitch and refusing to continue. FIFA is gathering official reports before referring the matter to its independent disciplinary committee. With the allegation still under investigation, Rupha Ramani looks at what happened during the England-Ireland U15 World Cup match and the wider challenge of tackling racism in football.
